'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Cooleo LS Rebel Strike Team (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cooleo]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Rebel Strike Team (V) / Garrison Destroyed (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Cooleo
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
